tasks.title: Create and Switch to Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure the model `mod8-refresh-lab` exists and is the active target.
hints: Run `juju switch mod8-refresh-lab` or `juju add-model mod8-refresh-lab`.

tasks.title: Deploy Workload Application
tasks.instructions: Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `service-node` into `mod8-refresh-lab`.

tasks.title: Perform Charm Refresh
tasks.instructions: Perform a charm refresh on `service-node` using `juju refresh service-node`.

tasks.title: Export Live Model Topology Bundle
tasks.instructions: Export the model topology to a bundle YAML file named `live-topology.yaml`.
